question: Who among the following was appointed as the Chairman of Indian Space Research Organisation in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. S Somanath.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Shri S. Somanath assumed the charge of **Secretary, Department of Space and Chairman,** Space Commission on **14 January 2022.** In his previous assignment, he was the** Director, of Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC),** the lead Centre responsible for Launch vehicle** technology development.**
